The '''Besn system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Besn]].
